abstract.p: We characterize off-target editing in primary cells.

sec.title: Introduction
sec.p: Base editors enable precise edits without DSBs.

sec.title: Methods
sec.p: We performed whole-genome sequencing in HEK293T cells.

sec.title: Cell culture
sec.p: Cells were maintained in DMEM with 10% FBS.

sec.title: Results
sec.p: Off-target rates were below 0.1% across 12 sites.
